acceptance_requires: dimension checks in Blender and exported GLB/FBX
correct hand grip without interpenetration or block-like anatomy
iron-sight alignment from rear-gunner eye camera
Igla missile originates from the front of the launch tube
PBR material separation for painted metal, polymer, rubber, glass, fabric, leather, and bare metal

Unreal close-view, daylight, overcast, wet, and night review

low-poly silhouette visible in ADS or cockpit close-up
